text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Treatment was completed for Hishi Amazon,
who was injured during practice.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Phew... Well, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? Training, of course!
There's plenty I can do even if I can't run.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If my legs are out of commission, I'll train my arms or my back.
No way I'm gonna fall behind just 'cause of an injury!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Guh…… ow-ow-ow-ow.
choice_data_list: Let's get plenty of rest until you've fully recovered.
Let's see if we can pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Why not?
Just doing some strength training shouldn't be a problem, right?
choice_data_list: We can't overlook the risk of it worsening.
We can't overlook the risk of it worsening.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"If you look at it that way, not practicing is
a way bigger risk!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm not panicking or anything...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...No, sorry for yelling like that.
choice_data_list: I'll put together a comeback plan for you.
I'll come up with a comeback plan.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please do.
I'll trust you and get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon was to take a break from training
until the pain in her legs subsided.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Then let's head straight to the gym—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon almost tumbled the moment she stood up,
so I instinctively caught and supported her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ow... ouch, ouch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Thanks Trainy, you really helped me out.
choice_data_list: Isn't practicing really out of the question?
Isn't practicing really out of the question?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
True, if I mess up, I might just make it worse.
I'll just head home quietly for today...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...You were planning to make me rest right from the start, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Still, you figured there was no way I'd just take your word for it, right...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Got it.
I'll make sure to get plenty of rest until I'm fully better!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Amazon decided to
take a quiet rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Then let's head straight to the gym—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I understand.
I'll do it in a way that puts as little strain on my legs as possible...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Man, this is gonna severely limit the kind of training we can do.
choice_data_list: Leave the training menu to me.
Leave the training menu to me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're saying you won't let me do it otherwise, right?
That's fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm dragging you into my stubbornness,
I promise I won't overdo it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, by continuing low-impact training mindful of
the injury, a quick comeback was achieved.
